title: Can LLMs Generate Novel Research Ideas?
body: Blind reviews by NLP experts rated LLM ideas more novel than human experts' ideas - but slightly less feasible.

title: Automating psychological hypothesis generation with AI
body: An LLM plus a causal graph from 43,312 psychology papers matched doctoral students on novelty; LLM alone did not.

title: Generative grounded theory (GGT)
body: A seven-step method for inductive theory building, with example prompts per step - AI as bounded cotheorist.
